intro: The Mocha Corner Table is compact yet purposeful. With its circular walnut veneer top and elevated rubberwood legs, Mocha delivers mobility, warmth, and functional styling for smaller spaces.

features.title: Walnut rubberwood finish for cohesive styling
features.text: The Mocha corner table’s MDF top is finished in patterned walnut veneer and is paired with a walnut-shaded rubberwood understructure. This cohesive tone enhances natural warmth while blending effortlessly into modern interiors.

features.title: Compact and mobile design
features.text: With a round top and lightweight form, this corner table moves easily between living rooms, bedrooms, or reading nooks.

features.title: Knockdown construction for practical assembly
features.text: The knockdown build of Mocha ensures ease of transport and setup without compromising strength.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
